yFromX.description:
Mapping that indicates which (if any) y inputs should come from which x input. This is useful in cases where the
underlying architecture contains an autoencoder. See {@link KerasConvertSpec#yFromX}.

sanitizedNames.description:
A mapping of sanitized output names to original output names. Since Keras allows model output names to contain
periods but {@link MlPipe}'s Tuple variable bindings do not, this field stores the link between the sanitized
names on this {@link KerasPipe} to the names in the native Keras model.

trainArgs.description:
Arguments passed to Keras's [fit](https://keras.io/api/models/model_training_apis/) method. Many of these arguments
are hyperparameters, and should be instantiated using {@link KerasConvertSpec#trainArgs} or modified using the
{@link #withHyperparams} API. Note that {@link KerasFitArgs#batch_size} and {@link KerasFitArgs#shuffle} set here
are ignored in favor of the respective fields set on {@link #generator}.

processArgs.description:
Arguments passed to Keras's [predict](https://keras.io/api/models/model_training_apis/) method. Many of these
arguments are hyperparameters, and should be instantiated using {@link KerasConvertSpec#processArgs} or modified
using the {@link #withHyperparams} API. Note that {@link KerasPredictArgs#batch_size} and
{@link KerasPredictArgs#shuffle} set here are ignored in favor of the respective fields set on
{@link #processGenerator}.

dataType.description:
Determines the type of data provided for Ml Training and Process and how to process it. Numerical is for 1-d numerical data, text
is for string data.

generator.description:
The keras model's data generator for sampling data for model training. Use {@link #withHyperparams} with the prefix
'generator' to define any custom arguments that should be provided for a custom generator.

```
pipe = pipe.withHyperparams({'generator/batch_size': 32, 'generator/custom_arg1': 50})
```

processGenerator.description:
The keras model's data generator for sampling data for inference. Use {@link #withHyperparams} with the prefix
'processGenerator' to define any custom arguments that should be provided for a custom generator.

```
pipe = pipe.withHyperparams({'processGenerator/batch_size': 32, 'processGenerator/custom_arg1': 50})
```

title:
Util methods common for {@link KerasPipe} which implements {@link MlAtomicPipe} and template pipe
implementation. For example see {@link KerasPipe}.
name: KerasPipe.FieldsAndUtils
